content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Bellevue

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional experience. Review PMI's specific hour thresholds for your background. Granite PM Academy can clarify whether you meet the entry requirements before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. You'll attend synchronous sessions online, interact directly with active certified practitioners, and cover all domains of the PMBOK® Guide. The flexible schedule accommodates working professionals across Bellevue's major employers and industries.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the 35-hour course, complete your PMI application through the Project Management Institute's portal. You'll document your education and project experience, then pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on application requirements and submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy offers focused exam-preparation support, including practice exams, study strategies, and Q&A sessions. Schedule your test at a Pearson VUE center or via remote proctoring. Our instructors are available to address final questions and reinforce high-impact concepts.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll enter a three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved activities—training, volunteer work, or conference attendance. PMI tracks your progress; Granite PM Academy can recommend continuing education pathways aligned with your career goals.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
